name: code-summary-to-teams
description: Send single-line code-change summaries (from git commits & Copilot chat) to a Microsoft Teams channel for a chosen time window.

commands.title: Code Summary: Pick Teams Channel for this Workspace
Code Summary: Clear Teams Channel for this Workspace
Code Summary: Sign in to Microsoft (Teams)
Code Summary: Sign out of Microsoft (Teams)

codeSummaryToTeams.aadClientId.description: (Advanced) Override the built-in Azure AD application (client) ID. Leave blank to use the extension's bundled multitenant app.

codeSummaryToTeams.aadTenantId.description: (Advanced) Override the AAD tenant. Leave blank to use 'organizations' (any work/school account). Set to your tenant ID to restrict sign-in.

codeSummaryToTeams.includeCommits.description: Include git commit subjects as summary lines.

codeSummaryToTeams.includeCopilotChat.description: Include single-line summaries derived from Copilot chat history (best-effort).

codeSummaryToTeams.maxLines.description: Maximum number of summary lines to send in one message.
